en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya Al Khash’amy, from Gayas Bin Ibrahim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said regarding the absconded (slave) of a Muslim: ‘He would be returned upon the Muslim’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said regarding a man who seized an absconding slave, so he absconded from him. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is nothing upon him’.
